title.narrative: Economic-territorial development master plan of Ciudad Juárez

description.narrative:
The municipality of Juárez is located in the state of Chihuahua, north of the Mexican Republic. Ciudad Juárez is its municipal seat and is also the main urban center of the entity. It is located on the border line with the Rio Grande and shares a binational border with El Paso, Texas.
In 2015, the total area of the municipality of Juárez was 3,577.7 km², of which 330.8 km2 (9.2% of its territory), made up its urban area. Its urbanization index is almost total, 99.6%, which is why it is considered a highly dynamic and densely populated municipality. From 2000 to 2015, Juárez experienced disorderly city growth. The urban area has expanded by 40%. With a density of 42 inhab./ha, the development model promoted so far has caused the inhabitants of Juárez to have to invest more time and resources to get around, in addition to not having adequate conditions of public transport and road infrastructure.
According to the CPI calculation, Juárez has moderately weak prosperity (51.21). This value is below the national average of the basic CPI (53.74 / 100). In 2017 the city had almost 1.4 million inhabitants, of which 37.8% lived in poverty. According to data from Coneval, by 2015 39.9% of the population received income below the welfare line, 14.5% suffered from deficiencies due to educational backwardness, and 13.7%, due to access to food. 85 areas have been identified that require priority attention to reduce poverty conditions, located in the west and southeast of the city.
The main objective of the collaboration is to contribute to lay the foundations of an inclusive and sustainable long-term territorial-economic policy that promotes sustainable economic and urban growth in the municipality of Juárez.
The project has a duration of 14 months and responds to the request of the municipality to receive support in elaboration of economic-territorial master plan in continuity to the recently developed Juarez 2040 City Vision and framed within the 2030 Agenda and its SDGs and the NUA.
The technical scope of the collaboration includes:
• Strengthened technical capacity of the municipal government of Ciudad Juarez to design and implement sustainable industrialization strategies and industrial policies from a contemporary and innovative approach based on integration with the territory. • Appropriate policy instruments for the implementation of the identified strategy, such as: industrial parks, industrial clusters, investment promotion, etc. • Strengthened institutional capacity of the municipal government of Ciudad Juarez for land management and governance, as well as to implement the industrial policy designed with a territorial approach. • Reduced territorial inequalities within the municipality, thanks to the promotion of specific sustainable industrialization actions based on the territorial advantages of the region. • Innovative and replicable territorial-industrial policy that considers the competitive advantages of Ciudad Juarez to promote endogenous development processes with a climate change perspective. • Comprehensive sustainable industrialization strategy including local economic dynamics with urban/regional, environmental, and social development analysis, with emphasis on gender, diversity, and vulnerable groups.
This new collaboration initiates the implementation of the recently developed Juarez 2040 City Vision jointly by UN-Habitat
This Vision aims to define a collective image of the future of Ciudad Juarez through a participatory approach. It includes the definition of a strategic framework integrated by defined objectives, goals, and localized actions. It also includes recommendations aligned with the New Urban Agenda pillars. After developing a situation analysis and an in site participatory process, the vision for the city integrates five objectives, 16 goals and 66 action lines which strategically cover the main five dimensions of the 2030 Agenda. These objectives describe how the city envisions itself in the year 2040.
The second of its five objectives is Prosper and Dynamic City. It gathers economic strategies by prioritizing, strengthening, diversifying and consolidating the municipality's economic activities.
The main goal of this objective is to reduce urban inequity by promoting the conditions for the creation of new job opportunities and, at the same time, leading activities into the improvement of infrastructure and services for visitors for positioning the city as an attractive destination for tourism and new investments. Additionally, this objective considers the consolidation of production districts by integrating the necessary services for attracting and consolidating specialized industry hubs and, therefore, building a strong base for urban economic development for the reduction of inequities.
